content.text: The search rate limit in `docs/limits.md` is out of date: production allows 120 requests per minute now. Update the doc.

# API limits

Limits are per API key. Bursts above the limit get HTTP 429.

| Endpoint | Limit | Burst | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /items` | 600/min | 50 | cached at edge |
| `POST /items` | 60/min | 10 | idempotency key required |
| `GET /search` | 60/min | 20 | `q` max 256 chars \| no wildcards |
| `POST /export` | 5/hour | 1 | async; poll `/jobs` |

Contact support to raise a limit.

The rest of the row is the same, including the escaped `\|` in the Notes cell, so the table still renders correctly. I didn't change the burst value of 20 because you only mentioned the per-minute rate; please confirm production still uses 20. `docs/changelog.md` already has a "2026-09: search limit raised in production" entry, so I didn't add one.
